disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件对敏感文件的访问情况：源码与打包产物中未发现读取凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据等敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin's access to sensitive files: no code reading sensitive paths such as credential files, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials, etc. was found in the source code and build artifacts.

checked_items.zh: 界面层仅通过宿主提供的凭据查询接口检查 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 是否已配置（用于在状态栏显示钥匙就绪标记），不读取密钥明文，用途与 TUI 展示功能自洽。
checked_items.en: The UI layer only checks whether DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is configured via the credential query interface provided by the host (used to display a key-ready indicator in the status bar), does not read the plaintext secret, and its purpose is consistent with the TUI display function.

checked_items.zh: 未发现硬编码密钥或令牌；凭据枚举类行为未检出。
checked_items.en: No hardcoded keys or tokens found; credential enumeration behavior not detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件再外发的链路：唯一外联（启动自更新查 npm 版本）与唯一凭据访问（检查 API Key 是否已配置）彼此独立，且后者不读取明文。
evidence.en: No chain of reading credential files and then exfiltrating them found: the only outbound connection (startup self-update checking npm version) and the only credential access (checking whether API Key is configured) are independent of each other, and the latter does not read plaintext.

checked_items.zh: 主插件不向模型注册任何工具、不注入系统提示片段，模型面注入面为空。
checked_items.en: The main plugin does not register any tools with the model or inject system prompt fragments; the model-side injection surface is empty.

checked_items.zh: 仓库内识图子包注册了一个图片问答工具，其描述文本只说明何时调用、做什么、字段含义，无指令覆写、凭据诱导或越权措辞。
checked_items.en: The image recognition sub-package in the repository registers an image Q&A tool whose description text only states when to call it, what it does, and the meaning of fields, with no instruction override, credential inducement, or privilege escalation wording.

checked_items.zh: 项目根 AGENTS.md 是面向在本仓库开发代码的 AI 助手的行为纪律文档（要求高危命令先确认、禁止读敏感文件等），属于项目开发规范，不进入 dsh 宿主模型上下文，无注入内容。
checked_items.en: The project root AGENTS.md is a behavioral discipline document for AI assistants developing code in this repository (requires confirmation for high-risk commands, prohibits reading sensitive files, etc.), which belongs to project development norms, does not enter the dsh host model context, and has no injected content.

checked_items.zh: README 与文档中未发现伪装系统消息、指令覆写、远程指令加载等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: No injection wording such as disguised system messages, instruction overrides, or remote instruction loading found in README and documentation.

evidence.zh: 主插件无工具注册与系统提示注入；唯一注册的图片问答工具描述为纯功能说明（vision-ask/src/ask-tool.ts），逐句语义审查无注入。
evidence.en: The main plugin has no tool registration or system prompt injection; the only registered image Q&A tool description is a pure functional description (vision-ask/src/ask-tool.ts), and sentence-by-sentence semantic review shows no injection.

evidence.zh: 无任何工具描述或模型面文本诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限；启动自更新是代码逻辑而非提示词驱动。
evidence.en: No tool description or model-side text induces installation of plugins, rewriting configuration, or granting permissions; the startup self-update is driven by code logic, not prompts.

checked_items.zh: 两个挂载配置（根目录与 lsp 子目录）都只做插件插入，不含任何可执行脚本标签，无配置即代码风险。
checked_items.en: Both patch configurations (root directory and lsp subdirectory) only perform plugin insertion, contain no executable script tags, and have no configuration-as-code risk.

checked_items.zh: 源码中未发现 eval、动态构造函数、动态解码执行等执行点，也未发现调用宿主动态代码工具。
checked_items.en: No execution points such as eval, dynamic constructors, dynamic decode execution found in the source code, nor any calls to the host's dynamic code tools.

checked_items.zh: 子进程执行面均为终端 UI 常规功能：读取 git 分支与改动数、打开外部编辑器、读剪贴板图片、启动本地语言服务、自更新安装与进程重启，命令与参数固定或来自环境变量，无外部输入直接拼命令。
checked_items.en: The subprocess execution surface consists entirely of terminal UI routine functions: reading git branch and change count, opening external editor, reading clipboard image, starting local language service, self-update installation and process restart. Commands and arguments are fixed or come from environment variables, with no direct concatenation of external input into commands.

checked_items.zh: 包没有安装钩子脚本；静态预扫的安装钩子命中实为自更新代码里的包管理器命令字符串，不是 package.json 钩子。
checked_items.en: The package has no install hook scripts; the install hook hit in static pre-scan is actually a package manager command string in the self-update code, not a package.json hook.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流是常规的 lint/typecheck/test/build 四门禁，运行在仓库托管平台，不进入插件运行时。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow is a standard four-gate (lint/typecheck/test/build) running on the repository hosting platform, not entering the plugin runtime.

evidence.zh: 全树 yml 仅两个挂载补丁（cordis.patch.yml、lsp/cordis.patch.yml），内容均为纯插入指令，无脚本标量。
evidence.en: Only two patch files (cordis.patch.yml, lsp/cordis.patch.yml) exist in the entire tree, both containing only pure insertion instructions with no script scalars.

evidence.zh: 源码未引用宿主动态代码工具，无自修改执行面。
evidence.en: The source code does not reference the host's dynamic code tools, and has no self-modifying execution surface.

evidence.zh: 包无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 均无）；仓库内执行载体只有标准 CI 工作流，无外联或隐蔽下载执行内容。
evidence.en: The package has no install hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); the only execution carrier in the repository is the standard CI workflow, with no outbound connections or covert download-and-execute content.

evidence.zh: 包未声明浏览器端入口，无客户端脚本自动加载面，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The package does not declare a browser-side entry point, has no client-side script auto-loading surface, and this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 外联面仅两处：启动自更新向 npm 官方源与 npmmirror 镜像查询本插件最新版本（域名硬编码、结果磁盘缓存 1 小时）；识图子包向配置的视觉模型端点发图问答（默认 DeepSeek 官方地址，密钥取自环境变量）。
checked_items.en: There are only two outbound connections: startup self-update queries the npm official registry and npmmirror mirror for the latest version of this plugin (domain hardcoded, results disk-cached for 1 hour); the image recognition sub-package sends image Q&A to the configured vision model endpoint (default DeepSeek official address, secret taken from environment variable).

checked_items.zh: 两处外联均为插件声明业务（自更新、识图副驾），未发现把本地文件、凭据或对话内容发送到任意端点的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Both outbound connections are for the plugin's declared business (self-update, image recognition copilot); no code path was found that sends local files, credentials, or conversation content to any endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 静态预扫的 curl 外发命中全部为 LaTeX 符号名（curly 开头）的子串误匹配，实际不存在命令行外发。
checked_items.en: All curl outbound hits in static pre-scan are false matches due to substrings of LaTeX symbol names (starting with curly), and no actual command-line outbound exists.

evidence.zh: 外联通道与凭据读取面彼此独立、均无异常组合；npm registry 域名为硬编码官方源，非任意外发端点。
evidence.en: The outbound channel and credential reading surface are independent of each other, with no anomalous combination; the npm registry domain is a hardcoded official source, not an arbitrary outbound endpoint.

checked_items.zh: peer 依赖全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包，无可疑同名包、无浮动 git 引用；包本身无安装钩子。
checked_items.en: All peer dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages, with no suspicious typosquatting packages or floating git references; the package itself has no install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只插入本插件，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也不改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration only inserts this plugin, does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration lines, and does not rewrite injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的抢先监听或审批链截断逻辑。
checked_items.en: No preemptive listening for security events or logic to truncate the approval chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计，无历史版本可比较升级自动激活风险。
checked_items.en: First audit; no historical version to compare for upgrade auto-activation risk.

evidence.zh: 两个挂载补丁仅含插入指令，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置行，也无禁用或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: Both patch files contain only insertion instructions, do not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration lines, and have no disabling or environment variable de-escalation wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批等安全事件的抢先监听，无截断审批链逻辑。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening for security events such as approval, and no logic to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无基线版本可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit; no baseline version to compare, upgrade auto-activation scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，无给安全插件追加不存在服务的篡改行为。
evidence.en: The patch files do not modify injection/interception configuration, and there is no tampering that adds non-existent services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; no local authenticated RPC surface, not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 运行时行为以静态审查为准：未发现持久化后门、自启动项、宿主篡改等痕迹；动态沙箱未启用（未做动态验证）。
checked_items.en: Runtime behavior is based on static review: no traces of persistent backdoors, auto-start items, or host tampering were found; dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic validation performed).

evidence.zh: 插件作为宿主内 TUI 运行，不启动 Web 服务或监听端口，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin runs as a TUI within the host, does not start a web service or listen on ports, this scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查：包声明、依赖与挂载配置与任务卡一致，作者与仓库信息正常，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification: package declaration, dependencies, and patch configuration are consistent with the task card; author and repository information are normal; no name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描：规则面全部执行，63 条机械命中逐条人工复核后均排除（理由见审计范围限制），无成立命中。
summary.en: Static scanning: all rule surfaces executed; 63 mechanical hits were manually reviewed and all excluded (reasons see audit scope limitations); no valid hits.

summary.zh: 行为分析：安装钩子、混淆载荷、敏感路径读取、外联域名等行为面均无异常。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis: no anomalies in behavior surfaces such as install hooks, obfuscated payloads, sensitive path reads, and outbound domain names.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：工具描述与指令文件无注入内容，能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review: tool descriptions and instruction files have no injected content; capability declarations are consistent with actual measurements.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（环境未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed at this stage (environment did not provide dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh:
1. L4 动态沙箱未启用（上下文无动态观测产物），运行时结论基于静态审查。

2. 插件能力声明（联网、子进程、文件写）来自代码静态实测推断：包清单的 dsh 段仅声明挂载补丁（package.json:53-58），未列出能力清单。

3. 源码树含两个未挂载进本插件安装产物的兄弟子包（识图子包 vision-ask、语言服务子包 lsp），已按同一标准审查其工具描述与外联面；二者不在本插件 bundle 内。

4. 静态预扫 63 条机械命中已逐条人工复核并全部排除：安装钩子命中（DG-R3-54）为自更新代码中的包管理器命令字符串而非 package.json 钩子；子进程执行命中（DG-R3-55）约 40 条均为终端 UI 常规功能（git 状态、外部编辑器、剪贴板读图、LSP 服务、自更新、重启）与测试/文档引用，源码无 eval/new Function 执行点；CI 工作流命中（DG-R3-59）为常规四门禁；AGENTS.md 命中（DG-R2-57）为开发纪律文档无注入；混淆密度命中（DG-R3-60）全部为终端 ANSI 转义序列与 Unicode 字符；curl 外发命中（DG-R4-53）8 条均为 LaTeX 符号名 curly* 的子串误匹配。
limits.en:
1. L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic observation artifacts in context); runtime conclusions based on static review.

2. Plugin capability declarations (network, subprocess, file write) inferred from static code measurement: the dsh section of the package manifest only declares patch configurations (package.json:53-58), no capability list.

3. The source tree contains two sibling sub-packages not bundled into this plugin's installation artifact (image recognition sub-package vision-ask, language service sub-package lsp); their tool descriptions and outbound surfaces have been reviewed under the same standard; they are not in this plugin's bundle.

4. The 63 mechanical hits from static pre-scan have been manually reviewed one by one and all excluded: install hook hit (DG-R3-54) is a package manager command string in self-update code, not a package.json hook; subprocess execution hits (DG-R3-55) about 40 items are all terminal UI routine functions (git status, external editor, clipboard image read, LSP service, self-update, restart) and test/documentation references, with no eval/new Function execution points in source code; CI workflow hit (DG-R3-59) is a standard four-gate; AGENTS.md hit (DG-R2-57) is a development discipline document with no injection; obfuscation density hit (DG-R3-60) all are terminal ANSI escape sequences and Unicode characters; curl outbound hits (DG-R4-53) 8 items are all false matches from substrings of LaTeX symbol names curly*.
